records.object: Ionic conductivity increase from 7.0 to 17.6 mS cm−1
records.quote: An antisolvent of poly(vinylidene fluoride-co-hexafluoropropylene) (PVDF-HFP) is added into the acetone solution of 1-ethyl-3-methylimidazolium dicyanamide (EMIM:DCA) that is an ionic liquid and PVDF-HFP prior to the ionogel formation.
context_quotes: This can significantly change the solid networks formed by PVDF-HFP and thus the microstructure of the EMIM:DCA/PVDF-HFP ionogels, thereby facilitating ionic transport.
As a result, the ionic conductivity of the ionogels can be increased from 7.0 to 17.6 mS cm(-1).
